scope: User-requested live simplification of S1445 and S2040 population layouts; additive source values retained only where directly reported; 2026-07-13

papers.note: 2026-07-13 user-requested correction: replaced the maturity-by-growth grid with one source-wide Total row. Direct total values from the primary paper are retained: 84 players, 782 injuries, 162,314 player-hours, incidence 4.82 (95% CI 4.49-5.17), mean time loss 23 days, and burden 113 (95% CI 105-121). Maturity and growth-rate analytic cells were intentionally removed from the active extraction layout; their former live state is retained in the correction audit.

studyDetails.title: The combined effects of growth and maturity status on injury risk in an elite football academy.

papers.note: 2026-07-13 user-requested correction: simplified the extraction to All players / PRO / U17 / U19. Direct cohort counts and age rows are retained from Table 1. The direct total of 144 non-contact lower-limb muscle injuries remains on All players only. The source reports incidence and return-to-play only by ACTN3 genotype, so all genotype-specific rate and recovery cells were intentionally removed rather than derived or reassigned to PRO, U17, or U19.

studyDetails.title: Higher Incidence and Longer Recovery Time from Non-Contact Muscle Injuries in ACTN3 XX Genotype Players from a Soccer Academy: A Three-Season Longitudinal Study.
